d: Delhi battles its most polluted Diwali in five years, with AQI levels nearing the severe category as smog, firecrackers, vehicle emissions and stubble burning choke the city. Meanwhile, Eternal founder Deepinder Goyal’s ₹85,000 wearable forehead device, Temple, faces criticism from doctors and clinical scientists over its unverified claims of measuring real-time brain blood flow. Hem Kaur Saroya examines Delhi’s worsening air pollution crisis, the fight for clean air and the controversy surrounding Goyal’s latest tech venture on Vantage on Firstpost.
